---
title: "NBA MVP Project"
format: html
---

```{=html}

<h1>NBA MVP MACHINE</h1>

<p>This is my MVP prediction dashboard.</p>

<div class="mvp-container">

<button class="mvp-btn" onclick="doSystem()">
PRESS TO GENERATE MVP
</button>

<div id="ball-container">
<img src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7a/Basketball.png" id="ball" width="120">
</div>

</div>

<div id="loader" style="display:none;">

<img src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7a/Basketball.png" class="ball">

<div class="loading-text">
<span id="percent">0%</span>
<p id="loadingMessage">Loading...</p>
</div>

<button id="continueButton" onclick="goToData()" style="display:none;">
Click to view data
</button>

</div>

<div id="dataContainer"></div>

<script>

function doSystem() {

  const loader = document.getElementById("loader");
  const loaderText = document.getElementById("percent");

  loader.style.display = "flex";

  let percent = 0;

  let interval = setInterval(() => {

    percent++;

    loaderText.textContent = percent + "%";

    if (percent >= 100) {

      clearInterval(interval);

      document.getElementById("percent").textContent =
        "100% Completed";

      document.getElementById("loadingMessage").textContent =
        "Data Loaded!";

      document.getElementById("continueButton").style.display =
        "block";
    }

  }, 30);
}

function goToData() {

  document.getElementById("dataContainer").innerHTML =
    "<h2>MVP data will go here</h2>";
}

</script>

```
